title: Puck: enable CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_WELL_KNOWN_CORE (+COAP_SERVER) in prj.conf for /.well-known/core
description: Child 1 of b7z9.41 (spec/11-lci.md 17.7 MUST set). Gateway enables CONFIG_COAP_SERVER=y + CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_WELL_KNOWN_CORE=y (apps/gateway/prj.conf:22-23); puck's prj.conf has neither, so /.well-known/core is absent on the constrained node. Add both lines to lichen/apps/puck/prj.conf (mirror gateway's values incl CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE if the standalone server needs it — check coap_server.c:449 BUILD_ASSERT MESSAGE_SIZE>=512+128 from the coap_keys overlay notes). Verify with a puck native_sim build (west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/apps/puck -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<lichen>) and confirm CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_WELL_KNOWN_CORE=y lands in .config; confirm the CI puck build gate (ec2-arm64.yml) stays green locally. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.41.
